summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute large obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a Kendo CSS theme (main is dist/index.css, source is SCSS) but ships a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13) to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line JavaScript file using rotated string-array indirection (function `WV8StW` shifts a large numeric+string dispatch table `n7gIxM` and every literal is resolved through that table) with no relationship to a CSS theme package. Executing the payload via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-only lifecycle inspection. The package also uses the `@servicetitan` scope (an existing SaaS company) with empty description, no author, and no repository metadata, consistent with a dependency-confusion / scope-impersonation lure targeting that organization's internal builds. Installing this version runs attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
